title: The flat base change map on sections: pullback of cohomology classes
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ and $g:S'\to S$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme] with fibre product $X'=S'\times_SX$ [def-pc-fibre-product], projections $f':X'\to S'$, $g':X'\to X$, and assume $g$ and $g'$ flat [def-weil-flat-morphism]. Let $\mathcal F$ be an $\mathcal O_X$-module, $\mathcal F'=g'^*\mathcal F$ [def-pc-module-pullback] and $p\ge0$. Let $\beta:g^*R^pf_*\mathcal F\to R^pf'_*\mathcal F'$ be the base change map (degree $p$ of the base change map $g^*Rf_*\mathcal F\to Rf'_*\mathcal F'$ of Stacks, Cohomology 02N7, $g^*$ being exact), and $\beta^\flat:R^pf_*\mathcal F\to g_*R^pf'_*\mathcal F'$ its adjoint. Then, under the descriptions of $R^pf_*\mathcal F$ and $R^pf'_*\mathcal F'$ as sheafified presheaves [lem-weil-pbc-higher-direct-image-presheaf], $\beta^\flat$ is the morphism induced by the maps of presheaves $H^p(f^{-1}(V),\mathcal F)\to H^p(f'^{-1}(g^{-1}(V)),\mathcal F')$, $V\subseteq S$ open, given by the pullback along $g'|:f'^{-1}(g^{-1}(V))=g'^{-1}(f^{-1}(V))\to f^{-1}(V)$ [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap] (b) (with $(g'|)^*(\mathcal F|_{f^{-1}V})=\mathcal F'|_{g'^{-1}f^{-1}V}$): for $\xi\in H^p(f^{-1}(V),\mathcal F)$ with image $[\xi]\in(R^pf_*\mathcal F)(V)$, $\beta^\flat_V([\xi])$ is the image of $(g'|)^*\xi$ in $(R^pf'_*\mathcal F')(g^{-1}(V))$.

source.place: Cohomology of Sheaves, Lemma 02N7 (lemma-base-change-map-flat-case, line 2977) and its proof (the map beta: I -> g'_*J lifting the adjunction map F -> g'_*g'^*F, pushed down by f_*), read with Remark 01FB (remark-explain-arrow) and Lemma 01E4 (lemma-describe-higher-direct-images); the description on sections is implicit in Stacks (statement assembled by the agent)
